title: St. Hippolytus Church in Helden
excerpt: Nearly 1,000 years of St. Hippolytus Church in Helden, from its 11th-century founding by Archbishop Anno II through its enduring role as a spiritual center.

title: Origins of the Wolfslayer Surname
excerpt: The German surname Wolfschläger, meaning 'wolf-slayer,' traces to medieval wolf hunters and became Wolfslayer in America through direct translation.
